description: A living room coffee table vignette photographed at seated eye-level with a normal lens, framing the surface of a white marble-top coffee table in a three-quarter view. Three ribbed white pillar candles of varying heights are lit and glowing at left and right of center, their warm flame light flickering. In the center of the arrangement sits a dark walnut-stained wooden box with an arched fireplace opening, decorated with a holiday garland, red stockings, golden bells, and gift-topped mantelpiece — its interior windows glow with an illuminated glitter-swirl scene featuring Santa Claus. A tall dark bronze mercury-glass vase with dried twigs and fairy lights stands to the upper left. In the soft-focus background, a houndstooth-pattern throw cushion is visible on a taupe sofa, and a warm amber glow from fairy lights on what appears to be a Christmas tree illuminates the background softly. The mood is cozy, festive, and warmly celebratory.
